channel.title: LoomSci - Quantum Physics
channel.description: Latest Quantum Physics articles from LoomSci

item.title: Harvesting Precision from the Exponential Sea: Engineered Randomness in Quantum Metrology
item.description: By tilting randomness with a single parameter, scientists harvest Heisenberg-limited precision from the exponential sea of quantum states, turning barren wilderness into a treasure trove.

item.title: The Photon's Time-Box: How Two Particles Meeting at a Mirror Could Transform Quantum Communication
item.description: Hong-Ou-Mandel interference at a beam splitter enables robust measurement of time-bin encoded quantum states, bypassing fragile interferometers.

item.title: When Top Quarks Climb the Quantum Ladder
item.description: Recent results from the Large Hadron Collider have demonstrated quantum entanglement of top quark-antiquark pairs using the spin degrees of freedom. Based on the doubly differential measurement of the spin density matrix of the top quark and antiquark performed by t...

item.title: Solving Semidefinite Programs with Thermal Bosons
item.description: Thermal bosons minimize their free energy, providing a physical blueprint for solving semidefinite programs through a Bose-Einstein regularisation.

item.title: Unlocking Quantum Gibbs States: The Code Swendsen-Wang Breakthrough
item.description: Code Swendsen-Wang dynamics lifts whole clusters across the free-energy barriers of quantum code Hamiltonians, enabling rapid sampling near phase transitions.

item.title: Conformal Floquet Dynamics Come to Life on a Quantum Processor
item.description: A quantum processor reveals hidden conformal symmetry in the periodic driving of a critical many-body system, marking a leap from theory to hardware.
